title_cn: 爱尔兰总理预计储蓄联盟年底前将取得进展
summary:
Progress on the European Union’s long-awaited savings and investment union will be possible by the end of the year, according to Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin. “It will benefit Ireland and it benefit Europe more generally,” Martin said during an interview with Bloomberg's Jennifer Duggan in Dublin. 

 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump’s New Birthright Citizenship Curbs Halted by Court
title_cn: 特朗普新的与生俱来的公民身份限制被法院叫停
summary: A federal judge blocked the Trump administration from carrying out for now the president’s latest effort to impose new limits on automatic birthright citizenship after losing an earlier legal fight before the US Supreme Court.

title: Ireland’s Martin Says Russia Is Becoming More Reckless
title_cn: 爱尔兰的马丁称俄罗斯正变得更加鲁莽
summary: Russia’s aggression is becoming an existential threat for the eastern members of the European Union, Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin said, as he condemned a drone attack in Germany that’s been blamed on Russia. “Russia is aggressive. And as we see in Leipzig, to a degree, very reckless as well now,” Martin told Bloomberg's Jennifer Duggan during an interview in Dublin. “And becoming more reckless in terms of what it’s looking at endeavoring to do on the side of European member states. This is a particular reality that we cannot ignore.” (Source: Bloomberg)
